description: List Canvas's own to-do items for you: assignments waiting for your submission, and items to grade if you are an instructor. Read-only. For a date-bounded view use list_upcoming_assignments; for one course use list_todo_for_course.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.

name: list_todo
title: List Todo
